what: Kaggle T4 SDPA pre-flight: why the plain-forward gate ran out of memory in fp16 resident capture
source: Kaggle notebook log, notebooke37bb78765 version 4 (scriptVersionId 354704375), cell running tools/sdpa_preflight.py; transcribed by hand from the log page

probes.desc: enable_gqa=True, is_causal, no mask (what transformers sdpa_attention_forward does when no mask is passed), default dispatch
probes.result: FAILED OutOfMemoryError: Tried to allocate 8.92 GiB

probes.desc: same with the memory-efficient kernel only
key/value heads repeated (repeat_interleave), is_causal, no mask
key/value heads repeated, bool block mask (the packed capture path)

earlier_runs.v1_v2_v3: plain-forward gate OOM with 8.93 GiB (worker 0) and 8.57 GiB (worker 1); pass B worker 1 finished 10 decisions with peak VRAM 7.53 GB and 9.26 s mean per ungated decision (9 decisions, shorter ones)
earlier_runs.note: v2 and v3 notebook runs used a stale dataset version (Kaggle pins a dataset to the version it was attached at)

conclusion: Root cause: transformers use_gqa_in_sdpa() returns True whenever no attention mask is passed; only the flash and math SDPA backends accept enable_gqa, a T4 (sm_75) has no flash kernel, so SDPA uses the math kernel and builds the full attention matrix. The packed path always passes a mask (repeat_kv, efficient kernel) and is unaffected. Fix: capture/capture_resident.py switches use_gqa_in_sdpa off on GPUs with compute capability < 8.
references: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/45776 (same bug on a T4 with torch 2.10.0, not merged)
https://github.com/multimodal-art-projection/YuE/issues/209 (efficient backend rejects enable_gqa, math fallback adds about 7 GiB)
not_reproducible_locally: On torch 2.14 with flash disabled the RTX 3050 shows 66 MiB for both paths (tools/test_resident_capturer.py), so the effect is torch-version specific
